mapper.select: SELECT V.* FROM T_CORE_METADATA M, T_CORE_METADATA_VALIDATOR V WHERE M.ID = V.ID AND V.ENABLE = '1' AND M.TABLENAME = #{table}
SELECT A.TABLENAME, A.COLUMNNAME, A.TYPENAME, B.* FROM T_CORE_METADATA A, T_CORE_METADATA_IMPVALIDATOR B WHERE A.ID = B.TARGETID AND A.TABLENAME = #{table} AND B.ENABLE = '1' ORDER BY A.COLUMNNAME

SELECT A.TABLENAME, A.COLUMNNAME, A.TYPENAME, B.* FROM T_CORE_METADATA A, T_CORE_METADATA_SUBMITVALIDATOR B WHERE A.ID = B.TARGETID AND A.TABLENAME = #{table} AND B.ENABLE = '1' ORDER BY A.COLUMNNAME, B.ORDERNO
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ${masterTable} M, ${table} T WHERE T.${referColumn} = M.ID AND T.ID = #{id}
